questions.q: What is the main purpose of a record type?
options: To let one object offer genuinely different picklist values, processes, and page layouts for different kinds of records
To control which users can log in during business hours
To set the org's default time zone per object
To define which currencies are active in the org
questions.explain: Record types let a single object (like Case) present different picklist values, a different business process, and a different page layout depending on what kind of record it is.

questions.q: For which objects does a record type require an associated process (Support, Sales, or Lead Process)?
options: Every object in Salesforce, without exception
Only custom objects
Case, Lead, and Opportunity specifically
No objects require a process; it's always optional
questions.explain: The lesson specifies that Case, Lead, and Opportunity record types each have an extra requirement: an associated process restricting their key status/stage picklist.

questions.q: What does a Support Process actually restrict?
options: Which profiles can log in to the org
A named, restricted subset of Case's Status picklist values
The org's fiscal year start month
Which Lightning app a user sees by default
questions.explain: A Support Process is a named, restricted subset of Case's Status values — the lesson parallels it with a Sales Process restricting Opportunity Stage.

questions.q: When creating a new record type, what does the 'Existing Record Type' field at the top of the wizard do?
options: It deletes the existing record type permanently
It specifies which existing record type's picklist values the new record type will clone from
It sets which profile can access the new record type
It determines which page layout is assigned by default
questions.explain: The New Record Type wizard starts by asking for an existing record type (often '--Master--') whose picklist values the new one is cloned from.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT something a single record type controls, according to the lesson?
options: Which picklist values are available
Which page layout a given profile sees for this record type
Which profiles can create a record of this type
The org's default business hours and time zone
questions.explain: Default business hours and time zone are org-wide Company Information settings, not something a record type controls — record types bundle picklist values, page layout assignment, business process, and profile access.
